$comment: Golden vectors for rtLogFleetOrderAttrNib (.x record type 11), the one
order operation with no example anywhere in the fixture corpus: nothing in
stars.2.7j.exe writes it (all 24 WriteMemRt call sites push another type),
so these cases are read out of the replay arm the host runs for it, at
1048:c3f0, rather than out of a file. See docs/formats/orders-x.md.
Consumed by the vector test in crates/stars-core/src/replay.rs.
One player, one fleet: object id 3, owner 0, two waypoints, both with no
task. Every case starts from that state and replays a log holding just

replay.source: FRunLogRecord case rtLogFleetOrderAttrNib, 1048:c3f0-1048:c508; payload { int16_t id; int16_t iOrder; int16_t value; }

cases.why: the ordinary case: waypoint 1 is told to colonize on arrival
Transport, the task whose payload the waypoint also carries
Transfer (9) is the largest value the arm accepts: 1048:c46e tests value >= 10
the first refused value, one past the end of the task enumeration
a full nibble is still not a task
the bound is tested against the whole value word, before the & 0x0F, so a value whose nibble alone would read as 'no task' is refused
the fleet has no waypoint 7: 1048:c462 tests FLEET.cord <= iOrder
no such fleet: LpflFromId returns NULL and the arm gives up
